name: Aoba-BBT,Inc.
summary: Aoba-BBT, Inc. operates in education in Japan, covering distance education, group education, international school management, content provision, and business and management content production. It also consults on distance learning systems, runs an IT management business, and manages a business university and graduate school. Formerly Business Breakthrough, Inc., it was renamed in 2023, incorporated in 1998 and has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
